title: stachys recta subsp. hayekii
intro: Stachys recta subsp. hayekii, commonly known as Mexican woundwort, is a plant species in the mint family, Lamiaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing, making it a valuable plant for treating various health issues. The health benefits of Mexican woundwort include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as pain relief, wound healing, and infection prevention. The plant's bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, are responsible for its medicinal properties, making it a valuable natural remedy for various health conditions.
